_comment: Pinned config for the KV-quality yardstick on cwe-4k. Do not point this at another model: every arm in bench/results/2026-10-27-s3-level-split was scored on the swift-IQ3_XXS weights below, and KL across models is not comparable. The app's own config (strata-swift-iq3_xxs.json in the repo root) is free to change - it was switched to the flash-next abliterated Q2_0 on 2026-10-27, which is why this copy exists. `env` stays empty on purpose: STRATA_KV_WINDOW there would turn every bulk arm into a window arm without it showing up in the run's seg.json.
